name: Quaquaval
description: Quaquaval, the Dancer Pokémon, and the evolved form of Quaxwell. A Water and Fighting type.
pokedex_entries: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
